journey.name: MOD-03: 会话与线程抽屉管理
journey.description: 验证用户能够通过左上角抽屉按钮滑出或展开侧边抽屉面板，查看当前网关关联的会话列表，点击新建对话生成新线程，或在不同历史会话间无缝切换。

actions.action: Click the navigation menu icon "打开会话抽屉" in top bar
Verify that the conversation drawer sheet is expanded and visible
Verify that the "新建对话" button is visible in the drawer
Verify that the drawer closes automatically or returns to workbench
Verify that the message timeline is reset to a clean state for the new conversation
Click the navigation menu icon "打开会话抽屉" in top bar again
Verify that the drawer contains at least one active conversation thread
Swipe left or tap outside the drawer sheet to dismiss it
Verify that the workbench is visible again
